scope: Case-by-case coverage of discovered Codex CLI and selected app-server runtime targets, combining original passes and environment-only focused retries. This is not a single green whole-suite invocation.
retained_original_failures: Original run failures and timeouts remain in the embedded original archive; focused passes do not rewrite those outcomes.
source_guards: Passing final-runtime-guards embedded in environment-controls evidence.
acceptance_limitations: Installed-app serial pass does not by itself identify the precise contention mechanism.
Temporary-path decode attribution remains separate from passing-case coverage.
Native runner cleanup and remaining platform gates are not established here.
